_about: The look of the video: subtitles, title, end card, the split's top zone and the boards. Sizes in px on the 1080x1920 frame (x wide_scale in 16:9). y = height of the text centre, 0 = top, 1 = bottom (y_wide in 16:9), in full frame; in the split the title and the boards sit in the top zone and the subtitles on the seam. Colours #RRGGBB, or #RRGGBBAA with opacity. Do not edit this copy: put the keys you change in ~/.config/video-editing/style.json.
